title: Man Pleads Not Guilty After Stolen Tesla Crash Leaves Woman Critically Injured
text:
A 39-year-old man has been charged with multiple felonies after allegedly stealing a Tesla and causing a serious injury to a woman podczas a high-speed chase on the Pacific Beach Boardwalk. The suspect, identified as Juan Antonio Gonzaba, is accused of driving under the influence and failing to stop for police, culminating in a collision that left the victim with significant injuries.
Juan Antonio Gonzaba, 39, was arraigned on Wednesday after a chaotic incident in which he allegedly stole a Tesla and seriously injured a 25-year-old woman during a police chase on Monday.
The blue Tesla was spotted in La Jolla around 12:30 p.m. and fled from officers, later crashing into a transformer before entering the Pacific Beach Boardwalk, where the victim was struck. Gonzaba, suspected of driving under the influence, faces multiple charges, including vehicle theft and assault with a deadly weapon. A plea of not guilty was entered, and the next hearing is scheduled for October 17th
